description: Examinations with no recorded pattern are treated as their own pattern group.

d.request: Find all distinct `ANA Pattern` values (treating NULL/empty patterns as a separate group), calculate the mean `aCL IgG` for each pattern excluding NULL values, identify patterns whose mean exceeds the mean of all pattern means, and for each above-average pattern report the pattern, its mean aCL IgG, the difference between that mean and the overall mean of pattern means, and the difference between that mean and the mean of the above-average patterns' means.
d.sql: WITH pattern_means AS (SELECT CASE WHEN `ANA Pattern` IS NULL OR TRIM(`ANA Pattern`) = '' THEN '[NULL/EMPTY]' ELSE `ANA Pattern` END as pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) as pattern_mean FROM Examination WHERE `aCL IgG` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN `ANA Pattern` IS NULL OR TRIM(`ANA Pattern`) = '' THEN '[NULL/EMPTY]' ELSE `ANA Pattern` END), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(pattern_mean) as overall_pattern_mean FROM pattern_means), above_average_patterns AS (SELECT pm.pattern, pm.pattern_mean FROM pattern_means pm CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE pm.pattern_mean > om.overall_pattern_mean), above_average_mean AS (SELECT AVG(pattern_mean) as mean_of_above_average FROM above_average_patterns) SELECT aap.pattern, aap.pattern_mean, aap.pattern_mean - om.overall_pattern_mean as diff_from_overall_mean, aap.pattern_mean - aam.mean_of_above_average as diff_from_above_average_mean FROM above_average_patterns aap CROSS JOIN overall_mean om CROSS JOIN above_average_mean aam ORDER BY aap.pattern_mean DESC;

c.request: Which ANA patterns (`ANA Pattern`) have an average `aCL IgG` (ignoring missing values) above the average of all the pattern averages? For each, show the pattern, its average aCL IgG, how far it is above that cross-pattern average, and how far it is from the average of these above-average patterns' averages. Examinations with no recorded pattern are treated as their own pattern group.
c.sql:
WITH pattern_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(`ANA Pattern`, 'No Pattern Recorded') as pattern,
    AVG(`aCL IgG`) as pattern_avg_acl_igg
  FROM Examination
  WHERE `aCL IgG` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(`ANA Pattern`, 'No Pattern Recorded')
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(pattern_avg_acl_igg) as overall_avg
  FROM pattern_avgs
),
above_avg_patterns AS (
  SELECT pa.pattern, pa.pattern_avg_acl_igg
  FROM pattern_avgs pa
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE pa.pattern_avg_acl_igg > oa.overall_avg
),
above_avg_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(pattern_avg_acl_igg) as above_avg_patterns_avg
  FROM above_avg_patterns
)
SELECT 
  aap.pattern,
  aap.pattern_avg_acl_igg as avg_acl_igg,
  aap.pattern_avg_acl_igg - oa.overall_avg as above_cross_pattern_avg,
  aap.pattern_avg_acl_igg - aap_m.above_avg_patterns_avg as distance_from_above_avg_mean
FROM above_avg_patterns aap
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
CROSS JOIN above_avg_mean aap_m
ORDER BY aap.pattern_avg_acl_igg DESC

b.request: For each distinct ANA Pattern value including NULL as its own pattern group, calculate average aCL IgG (excluding NULL aCL IgG values); identify patterns whose average exceeds the mean of all pattern-group averages; for those above-average patterns, report the pattern, average aCL IgG, its deviation above the cross-pattern mean, and its deviation from the mean of the above-average patterns' averages.
b.sql: WITH pattern_averages AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern`, AVG(`aCL IgG`) as pattern_avg_acl_igg FROM Examination WHERE `aCL IgG` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(pattern_avg_acl_igg) as overall_mean FROM pattern_averages), above_average_patterns AS (SELECT pa.`ANA Pattern`, pa.pattern_avg_acl_igg FROM pattern_averages pa, overall_mean om WHERE pa.pattern_avg_acl_igg > om.overall_mean), above_average_mean AS (SELECT AVG(pattern_avg_acl_igg) as mean_of_above_average FROM above_average_patterns) SELECT aap.`ANA Pattern`, aap.pattern_avg_acl_igg, aap.pattern_avg_acl_igg - om.overall_mean as deviation_above_cross_pattern_mean, aap.pattern_avg_acl_igg - aam.mean_of_above_average as deviation_from_above_average_mean FROM above_average_patterns aap CROSS JOIN overall_mean om CROSS JOIN above_average_mean aam ORDER BY aap.pattern_avg_acl_igg DESC
b.raw: For each distinct ANA Pattern value including NULL as its own pattern group, calculate average aCL IgG (excluding NULL aCL IgG values); identify patterns whose average exceeds the mean of all pattern-group averages; for those above-average patterns, report the pattern, average aCL IgG, its deviation above the cross-pattern mean, and its deviation from the mean of the above-average patterns' averages.

a.request: Group the examinations by `ANA Pattern`, treating examinations with no recorded pattern as a group of their own, and compute each group's average `aCL IgG` (ignoring missing values). Keep the patterns whose average is above the mean of all the group averages (each group counted once). For each, show the pattern, its average aCL IgG, how far it is above that mean, and how far it is from the mean of the kept patterns' averages.
a.sql: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT COALESCE(`ANA Pattern`, 'NO PATTERN') as pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) as avg_acl_igg FROM Examination WHERE `aCL IgG` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(`ANA Pattern`, 'NO PATTERN')), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) as mean_val FROM group_averages), filtered_patterns AS (SELECT ga.pattern, ga.avg_acl_igg FROM group_averages ga WHERE ga.avg_acl_igg > (SELECT mean_val FROM overall_mean)), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) as mean_val FROM filtered_patterns) SELECT fp.pattern, fp.avg_acl_igg, fp.avg_acl_igg - (SELECT mean_val FROM overall_mean) as above_overall_mean, fp.avg_acl_igg - (SELECT mean_val FROM kept_mean) as from_kept_mean FROM filtered_patterns fp ORDER BY fp.pattern
